frontier: J-Space/GWT training material could carry syntactically valid but causally transplanted Entry/Route/GRID10 identities unless dataset admission re-binds admitted prototype, transition and training traces.

unusual_experiment.name: JSPACE_CAUSAL_ID_TRANSPLANT_DATASET_FALSIFIER
unusual_experiment.intervention: Substitute a different syntactically valid entry_event_sha256 into a training trace while preserving registry admission for that altered trace.
unusual_experiment.pre_repair_prediction: A format-only/self-consistent training-trace path can accept the transplanted causal label because it does not reconstruct the Entry->Route->GRID10 causal path.
unusual_experiment.post_repair_required_result: Dataset admission rejects the trace because transition and training causal identities disagree.

source_findings: jspace_gwt_prototype_v1.py already binds Entry, RouteDecision, GridPlan, generation, cell, role and vector-control identities fail-closed.
jspace_training_trace_v1.py accepts caller-supplied causal SHA fields and validates their format but does not itself reconstruct Entry/Route/GRID10 objects.
the existing training-trace unit fixture used arbitrary valid 64-hex causal identifiers, demonstrating the source-level provenance seam.
compile_jspace_bootstrap_dataset_v1.py is a bootstrap/self-consistency compiler and is not by itself sufficient one-shot-training admission authority.

delta.effect: Require exact registry admission and cross-binding of prototype, transition and training traces across generation, cell, role, basis bytes and Entry/Route/GRID10 identities; credited outcomes require admitted causal binding.

evidence_boundary.next_exact_gate: Actually start the exact-source FREE isolated retained controller run, bind current Research main SHA/tree plus PR1263 SHA/tree, prove credential nonpersistence, and observe the combined regression result.
evidence_boundary.free_only_next: After exact FREE executable evidence, continue zero-cost local ~0.8B loader/J-Space/GWT work only.
